verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a public REST API with bearer-token authentication, global and team-scoped tokens, and per-endpoint references for creating, updating and deleting monitors, including copyable curl examples. The docs also point to programmatic integration through APIs and Terraform. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the common paths, but that does not undercut the documented API. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), evidence that API coverage extends beyond Uptime resources (e.g. logs/telemetry), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: A global API token is a token valid across all your teams, for managing anything within Better Stack.
Simply include an `Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN` header in your requests.
